newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares leap, volume also gains.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares leap, volume also gains.

text.p: Lithuanian shares registered one of their highest gains since last year and volumes were healthy on Tuesday with dealers predicting that this trend would continue.
The leading group A index leapt by 256.34 points to 2,305.41 and volume on the central market was 1.1 million litas.
This was outstripped on the bloc market, where trade was 2.21 million litas and the T-bill market, where turnover was 2.02 million litas.
"Today we saw the highest share rise since April (1996) and although doubts remain about the pace, the trend for more share prices rises remains," said one dealer from a leading brokerage.
Ukio Bank and Hermis Bank saw some of the leading gains.
Ukio gained to 31.68 litas from 26.4 litas on turnover of 107,078 litas on the central market and 145,000 litas in bloc trading at 29 litas.
Hermis climbed to 235 litas from 221 litas on trade of 99,640 litas on the central market while registering turnover of 1.79 million litas in bloc deals at 235 litas.
Lithuanian Gas remained busy on 261,202 litas turnover and went up to 1.92 litas from 1.90 litas while Birzai Milk added 0.5 to 9.5 litas on trade of 55,000 litas.
The Ragutis brewery showed increasing activity as it rose to 12.3 litas from 10.25 on trade of 119,162 litas.
